outcomes.signature: site-root certification and exact digest pin green; source capture committed 11 managed entities; hostile target first refused four post/term slug collisions and then applied with explicit posts,terms adoption (create 5, update 2, adopt 4, applied 11); source post 5, attachment 6 and category 2 rebound to target post 18, attachment 17 and category 7; canonical post metadata contained the target home URL and target reference ids; the native Rank Math redirection returned 302 to the target destination twice while its runtime hit counter advanced independently; canonical-recapture/v1 passed and the repeat plan reported create 0, update 0, unchanged 11 with no drift, conflicts, collisions, adapter blockers or environment gaps.

source: Historical site-adapter authoring exercise on disposable pair rmauthor (WordPress 7.1, PHP 8.3, MariaDB). Rank Math SEO 1.0.277 was installed from the locally verified downloads.wordpress.org artifact (sha256 7fb596fad0b82ef4c2a5fede32aa91f0b645658027c20ac2ffa5cd5979eea616) on both sides. Source state was authored through the plugin setup wizard, its authenticated REST writers and real HTTP traffic; the adapter then ran certify -> exact pin -> capture -> deploy -> plan -> apply -> canonical recapture against an independently populated hostile target. Version 1.0.276 was installed only as the below-range refusal control, so it has no green outcome row.
